代入 $t = kx$，$dt = k\,dx$：

$$\int_0^\infty e^{-k^2 x^2}\,dx = \frac{1}{k}\int_0^\infty e^{-t^2}\,dt.$$

记 $A := \int_0^\infty e^{-t^2}\,dt$。则

$$\boxed{I'(k) = -2A\,e^{-k^2}.}$$

$$\int_0^\infty I'(k)\,dk = -2A\int_0^\infty e^{-k^2}\,dk = -2A\cdot A = -2A^2 = -2\left(\int_0^\infty e^{-t^2}\,dt\right)^2. \quad\checkmark$$

$$A^2 = \int_0^{\pi/2}\!\int_0^\infty e^{-r^2}\,r\,dr\,d\theta = \left(\int_0^{\pi/2}d\theta\right)\!\left(\int_0^\infty r\,e^{-r^2}\,dr\right).$$

对于径向积分，代入 $u=r^2$，$du=2r\,dr$：

$$\int_0^\infty r\,e^{-r^2}\,dr = \frac{1}{2}\int_0^\infty e^{-u}\,du = \frac{1}{2}.$$

因此

$$A^2 = \frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2} = \frac{\pi}{4}.$$

$$\lim_{k\to\infty} I(k) = \frac{\pi}{2} - 2\cdot\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{\pi}{2} - \frac{\pi}{2} = 0.$$
